/-! Green's Open Problem 12 — imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (FormalConjectures/GreensOpenProblems/12.lean at d8d031d4998c78575159ccab9a7a9e95ce043883, Apache-2.0); stated as the registry states it; the names it takes from its file or the registry's library are ported mechanically under defs/ (R12, F14-T19). open Finset

theorem Opn.green_12 :
    ∀ {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G],
    ∀ (A : Finset G),
    let N := Fintype.card G
    let α := (A.card : ℝ) / N
    let valid_tuples : Finset ((Fin 5 → G) × (Fin 5 → G)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun t =>
      ∀ i : Fin 5, ∀ j ∈ ({i, i + 1, i + 2} : Finset (Fin 5)), t.1 i + t.2 j ∈ A)
    (valid_tuples.card : ℝ) ≥ α ^ 15 * (N : ℝ) ^ 10 := by
  sorry
